description: The bounded closure on finite \(S\) is contained in every restricted congruence on \(S\) containing its input equations.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.closure_least.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Functions n)] (S : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.GroundTerm L))
  (E : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.TermPair L)) (_hE : E ⊆ S.product S)
  (r :
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.GroundTerm L →
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.GroundTerm L → Prop)
  (hr : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.IsCongruence S r) (hEr : ∀ p ∈ E, r p.1 p.2)
  (p : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.TermPair L) :
  p ∈ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.closure S E → r p.1 p.2
